label: gold_reference_issue
description: Gold answer disagrees with its own program or was flagged in review

label: unit_or_scale_error
description: Final answer off by a power of 1000

label: unsupported_number
description: Equation input not found in the evidence

label: arithmetic_error
description: A written equation is arithmetically wrong

label: rounding_only
description: Within 1% of gold but not equal at gold precision

label: wrong_value_unexplained
description: Wrong value; arithmetic and inputs look fine or were not extracted (metric, denominator or period suspected)

label: refusal
description: Model said the question cannot be answered

label: no_final_answer
description: No final value stated (e.g. lists values only)

label: not_formalizable_by_stage1
description: No equation could be extracted by Stage 1 v2
